mapper.select: SELECT p.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as userName, u.avatar_url as user_avatar, FALSE as liked FROM social_post p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{current}

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as userName, u.avatar_url as user_avatar, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as liked FROM social_post p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN social_like l ON p.id = l.post_id AND l.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{current}

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as userName, u.avatar_url as user_avatar, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as liked FROM social_post p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN social_like l ON p.id = l.post_id AND l.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_post WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as userName, u.avatar_url as user_avatar, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as liked FROM social_post p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN social_like l ON p.id = l.post_id AND l.user_id = #{userId} JOIN social_follow f ON p.user_id = f.following_id AND f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{current}
